sentences.text: Baharipristis bastetiae is an extinct genus of saw-snouted shark belonging to the family Sclerorhynchidae. This species falls within the class Chondrichthyes, which includes all cartilaginous fish.
Fossils of Baharipristis were found in the Bahariya formation, a site also holding remains of at least nine other genera of Sclerorhynchid saw-snouted sharks.
The species lived between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage of the Late Cretaceous period.
